phrase: A chip maker's leadership shake-up rattled investors today. The same day, a search giant launched a smarter model, a sharper search tool, and new glasses.
phraseAlternatives: A chip maker lost its chief executive amid scandal, and investors took notice. Elsewhere, a search giant rolled out a smarter model and stylish new glasses.
One company's chief executive resigned in scandal today, rattling its investors. Another company spent the day showing off a smarter model and new glasses.
A chip maker's boardroom scandal cost it a chief executive today. A rival calmly launched a smarter model, sharper search, and new glasses.
alt: A blueprint building has its door open with an empty yellow chair sliding out beside a falling chart, labeled CHIEF RESIGNS. Across a dividing line, a cheerful robot steps from a bow-topped box while a calm person wears new glasses, labeled RIVAL LAUNCHES.

brief.concept: A chip maker's chief executive resigns amid scandal as markets wobble, while right next door a rival company calmly unveils a smarter model, smarter search, and a pair of smart glasses.
brief.metaphor: A toppling company tower losing its chief's chair through the front door, beside a calm rival handing out shiny new gadgets as if nothing happened.
